behaviors.description: Control retention of unrelated orphan payload through transaction pruning settings.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app A/B updates, a second app's removed local ref, and a server capable of withholding file content while serving metadata.
behaviors.expected: Disabled pruning retains the second app's payload for a content-free repull; enabled pruning removes it and a blocked-content repull fails. Each update deploys exact B before reset to A.

behaviors.description: Choose static deltas or loose payload during a transaction update.
behaviors.preconditions: Copied independent A/B repositories with an OSTree-generated A-to-B static delta and request-recording HTTP server.
behaviors.expected: Default/disabled/default delta settings alternate delta and loose-payload requests while all updates deploy exact B.

mappings.rationale: Identical blocked-content repulls distinguish retained from pruned unrelated orphan objects across opposing transaction settings.

surface_assertions.rationale: True/false/true settings alternate payload-free repull success with blocked-payload failure for an unrelated removed ref after updating A to B.

mappings.rationale: Server observations distinguish actual static-delta use from ordinary file downloads with both transfer paths yielding independent B.

surface_assertions.rationale: Opposing settings select delta URLs versus loose file payloads in recorded HTTP requests.

notes: Network evidence observes public transfers; no private target repository files are inspected.
